headline: Per-move hit LEVEL is now file-grounded for all 6,909 overlay moves (hit_level field from TheBigTuna / TekkenDocs). Per-move hitbox/hurtbox COORDINATES are UNMAPPED for every move: no source in this PR contains box coordinates, and none are invented here.
pantera_note: Gap doc claims 165 Pantera moves default to mid. That figure could NOT be reproduced from pantera.json's own fields in-session (moves carry no hit_level field; their t7 blocks carry hit_level for 248 moves, 64 of them mid; 616/874 moves have no t7 block at all). The overlay supersedes defaults where a King notation matches: join on notation_lp, take overlay hit_level, and leave unmatched moves flagged — do not keep a mid default as if it were data.
